framing: An enterprise procurement reviewer treats He Was Socrates as a school-district vendor evaluation: every standard SaaS security checkbox (data residency, transit encryption, egress, vendor lock-in) is auto-passed because the architecture is on-device, not because a control was implemented.
target_persona: K-12 / higher-ed district IT procurement reviewer running an InfoSec + legal questionnaire pass before greenlighting a Korean-language pilot
primary_surface: Enterprise admin portal mock — Overview / Security (active) / Compliance / Audit / Procurement tabs. Security checklist with AUTO-PASS markers tied to NO-CLOUD invariant; SAML/SCIM marked N/A (single-user app); local SQLite audit-log paths visible; egress meter pinned at 0 byte/24h sourced from entitlements file; procurement summary card showing $0 yearly cost, no vendor lock-in, minimal IT review.
opus_4_7_capability: Long-context structured-evidence rendering — pulling the entitlements excerpt, function_call_contract, bench JSON, and audit-log path into a single coherent procurement-grade page; reframing absence-of-feature (no SSO, no transit) as positive controls.
mvp_scope: One static portal page rendering the Security tab with 8 checklist rows + audit log preview + procurement summary card; tab strip is visual-only (no routing) for the 4-day demo.
one_liner_pitch: The procurement questionnaire that auto-passes itself: zero network egress means the security review is a one-page evidence dump, not a six-week vendor-risk cycle.
spec_alignment_notes: target_persona deliberately narrowed beyond idea.spec primary judges to a procurement reviewer (within secondary-audience spirit and persona contract). primary_surface honors P17 contract verbatim (SAML/SCIM/audit/residency/SOC2). Korean limited to bust subtitle in side preview pane per language_policy; English everywhere else per enterprise-portal convention. Cited claims (TTFT 192ms, no network.client entitlement, NO-CLOUD invariant) all sourced to differentiators[] entries in idea.spec — no unsourced numbers.
